commits.subject: Preserve web search provider ownership across thread resumes (#62144)
commits.reason: Keep the search provider that produced references when a thread is resumed or forked. Preserve the explicit Unused checkpoint and conservative handling of older history so hosted search cannot fall back to a different provider after recording references.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 40eeff9f21ed304099a7cc084c6a976bc57656d2ea1f1c5376923cc609b13fcf.
The new optional checkpoint is read from the borrowed original rollout and compacted history. It takes precedence over legacy search attribution and native-fallback metadata.
ALab persistent and ephemeral recovery already restore annotated InitialHistory before session startup. Owned metadata literals use defaults and no extra provider authority is required.
commits.revisit: Verify search owner with metadata-free histories, explicit provider choice, and annotated recovery on both ordinary resume and native exec.

commits.subject: Signal workspace routing readiness in account updates (#62145)
commits.reason: Carry the optional workspace-routing-ready reason through retained account updates. The event reports the completed discovery of the same account and leaves the live account owner and routing decision with the existing backend.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 d764deb4e3ea04711977cc0efe092baf782421d6504a56644122beb76cd11478.
One existing connection-targeted notification gets the new reason after workspace routing succeeds and the owner generation still matches. The guarded enqueue retains that established owner check.
Other account updates carry no reason. Older payloads decode as optional and unknown reason values remain tolerated. The ALab account identity fixture needs an explicit ordinary reason field.
commits.revisit: Exercise startup routing, workspace switch and logout, including a late discovery result from the retired owner, and check optional reason compatibility in the SDK.
